digest.component_or_area: BindingStore baseline storage and field normalization
propositions: Baseline storage must normalize description through `normalize_rich_text(raw)` and status/priority to exact Jira `name` strings while preserving assignee as raw vendor dict unchanged
Projection through the inbound mapper's canonical `map_remote_to_local` path produces identical live comparison verdicts for vendor-shaped and scalar-equivalent baseline values
Assignee dict preservation across all identity forms (email, accountId, displayName) prevents local-wins overwrites during concurrent remote edits and maintains inbound suppression
Serialized baseline size must reduce by at least 50% from approximately 18,257,550 bytes through normalized field projection without functional mutation deltas
Pre-A3 reader must accept both scalar and vendor-dict forms to enable safe rollback through single-change revert without data rewrite
Stored baselines remain stable under idempotent projection and preserve field absence for summary and assignee while normalizing description and status/priority fields
